items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the guys who were born and raised here, like you and Bishop and all the other guys

ctx.x: That was nice. Was there a certain way of playing in Chicago? You know, the guys who were born and raised here, like you and Bishop and all the other guys, was there a particular style of playing? You know, like they talk about New Orleans style, they talk about Texas style of playing, New York style, was there a Chicago style of playing?

Well, yes and no. Because when -- like when I first started playing, most of the musicians I worked with was from New Orleans. And they played that old New Orleans style. And later years, they come -- they started what they called the Chicago style, which I didn't see much difference. All I knew; I was playing music. I never paid much attention to the style.
